input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: Section 12 gives a strong software conformance warranty (one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, plus the acceptance period and any maintenance-covered period), which exceeds the 90-day fallback floor. However, the fallback fails on two material terms: (i) there is no warranty of any duration covering Garman's services (installation, training, Maintenance Services) — nothing in Sections 4, 5, 9 or 10 warrants performance quality; and (ii) Section 12 states no remedy. The only repair mechanic (Section 10(c), p0077) is a best-efforts maintenance service conditional on paid maintenance, and the only money-back mechanic (Sections 7-8) is confined to the acceptance period, is "in lieu of any other remedy" and terminates the Agreement, so there is no refund remedy for warranty breach. We therefore propose the shortest fallback cure: a 30-day services warranty and an express repair/replace-or-refund remedy for the Section 12 warranties. There is no general warranty disclaimer, so the express warranty is not swallowed.

proposal.summary: Add a 30-day services warranty and express repair/replace or refund remedy to Section 12
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12 gives us a one-year Software conformance warranty but no services warranty and no stated remedy, so we have added our fallback position: a 30-day professional and workmanlike services warranty and a repair, replacement or refund remedy for breach of the Section 12 warranties.

ops.text: Garman warrants that the services provided under this Agreement, including installation, training and Maintenance Services, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for a period of thirty (30) days following their performance. Sparkling's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 12 is, at Garman's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Software or services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Software or services.
